actual: ShellPredBacktestExecutor applies pred-backtest conf overrides only when backtest_config.command is absent. Production combine-backtest always supplies a WSL command, so submitted topk/strategy_kwargs are persisted in backtest_config_json but the actual workspace conf.yaml keeps template defaults such as topk=25, causing succeeded runs with incorrect metrics and no warning. Fix must apply overrides before both command and command-None execution paths, fail loud on invalid conf structure, and add regression coverage for command path topk/strategy_kwargs.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
